_comment: Lists the user wants back whole (places, foods, cities). Each list is stored two ways: shape 'list' = one note (subject = the list title) with one entry per item; shape 'notes' = one note per item (subject = item name). `key` is how the bench recognises an item in search output (case-insensitive substring of a title or entry line). Queries are the phrasings Claude would send.
